test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence which gives the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bite the bullet

options.text: The children played in the park on a sunny day.
Despite the pain, Sarah decided to go ahead with the surgery.
The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.
Jack and Jill went up the hill to fetch a pail of water.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bite the bullet"** means to endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable. (कठिन परिस्थिति का सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Knowing that the project was due soon, she decided to bite the bullet and start working on it immediately.
 
 
 
• **Option 2** explains the idiom correctly as it describes Sarah deciding to go ahead with the surgery despite the pain, which is an unavoidable situation. (कठिन परिस्थिति का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the pain, Sarah decided to go ahead with the surgery.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: **The children played in the park on a sunny day. (बच्चे धूप वाले दिन पार्क में खेले।)

 
 
• **Example:** The children played in the park on a sunny day.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: **The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests. (शेफ ने मेहमानों के लिए एक स्वादिष्ट भोजन तैयार किया।)
 
 
• **Example: **The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: **Jack and Jill went up the hill to fetch a pail of water. (जैक और जिल पानी की बाल्टी लाने के लिए पहाड़ी पर गए।)
 
 
• **Example:** Jack and Jill went up the hill to fetch a pail of water.
